name: Hair Vitamin Gummies

Each daily serving also contains Vitamin A, Pantothenic Acid, Vitamin B6, Folic Acid, Vitamin B12, Vitamin D, Vitamin E, Iodine, Choline and Inositol, providing a comprehensive blend for anyone looking for a single supplement to support healthy, shiny hair. The gummies are sugar free and free from dairy, gluten, soy, artificial colours, flavours and preservatives, and suitable for vegetarians.

name: Creatine Gummies
description: HealthAid® Creatine Gummies are a mess-free alternative to creatine powder, no mixing, no scooping, no chalky aftertaste, just tasty lemon flavoured gummy you can take anywhere. The gummies are formulated for athletes and active individuals who want to support muscle strength, power and performance during high-intensity training. A serving of three gummies provides a full 3g dose of Creatine Monohydrate, the amount shown to support physical performance in successive bursts of short-term, high-intensity exercise. The gummies are sugar free and free from dairy, gluten, soy, artificial colours, flavours and preservatives, and suitable for vegans.

longDescription: Collagen is the main structural protein found in our body's connective tissue (skin, joints, bones, hair, nails, muscles, and tendons). It supports beauty, skin elasticity and hydration, joint mobility, bones, muscles, and general health of the connective tissue. HealthAid Marine Collagen Powder is rich in type 1 as well as type 2 and 3 Collagen. It is Hydrolysed to reduce the size of the Collagen molecules thus ensuring better absorption and bioavailability. Supplementing with natural collagen is essential for maintaining healthy-looking skin and joint mobility. The skin is the body’s largest organ and Collagen is the major structural protein of the skin, which gives it strength, smooth and glowing appearance. As we age, Collagen levels decline, and levels of free radicals in the skin increase due to the effects of exposure to harmful UV rays and environmental factors. Cosmetic creams, lotions and serums work on the top layer of skin – the epidermis. However, the skin’s overall quality, moisture-retaining ability and resilience are determined in the deeper, structural layer - the dermis – where the collagen, elastin and moisture-retaining elements are found. Hydrolysed Marine Collagen Powder acts as a skin rejuvenator from inside out because it is especially rich in the beneficial Type I Hydrolysed Collagen to provide the optimum support for healthy, glowing skin. Type I Hydrolysed Collagen is the most abundant in the body and is considered to be the key building matrix protein that gives the skin its structure and firmness. Being “hydrolysed” it has higher bioavailability (90-95%) and can be easily absorbed and transported to the dermis of the skin.

longDescription: Bone constitutes the fundamental part of our joints. For movements to be smooth and joints to be flexible there must be a layer of cushioning and lubrication between the bones. This layer is made up of a shock-absorbing tissue called cartilage and a natural fluid called synovial fluid. Healthy cartilage and synovial fluid make it possible for joints to move easily and comfortably. Osteoflex® Sport provides ideal nutritional joint health support for recreational and professional athletes as well as gym goers and all physically active people. It contains vegetarian Glucosamine fortified with Vitamin C, Manganese, and Curcumin (Turmeric Extract). Vitamin C contributes to collagen formation crucial for the function of cartilage and bones, which is important for the growth and repair of connective tissue. Glucosamine is present in relatively high concentrations in the joints and connective tissues, and is necessary for cartilage repair and maintenance. It helps cartilage to be more flexible. Manganese is an important mineral that contributes to the maintenance of normal bones and connective tissue formation. Turmeric is a natural anti-inflammatory agent which has been known to be beneficial for those who want to maintain joint health.

longDescription: Bio-Folate tablets contain L-methylfolate (5-MTHF) which is a superior alternative to Folic Acid as it is a stable, safe and highly biologically active form of Folate (Vitamin B9). Unlike Folic Acid, L-methylfolate doesn’t require an enzyme for its conversion. For this reason, L-methylfolate is the best option particularly for those with MTHFR mutation, as they can’t metabolise Folic Acid. Folate is a member of the B group vitamins. It plays an important role in normal blood formation and amino acid synthesis. It contributes to the reduction of tiredness and fatigue, homocysteine metabolism, immune and psychological function, and normal maternal tissue growth during pregnancy. Deficiency of Folate leads to fatigue and tiredness, anaemia (usually combined with B12 deficiency), painful mouth sores, poor memory and focus, low mood, depression, insomnia, and dark skin spots. Increased risk of birth defects is also linked to the deficiency of Folate (as well as vitamin B12). For this reason, the Government’s Chief Medical Officer advises that all women planning a pregnancy should take 400?g of supplemental Folate daily from start of trying to conceive until the 12th week of pregnancy. Vitamin B9 (Folate) contributes to the maintenance of healthy heart function, normal blood pressure, blood cholesterol and glucose levels. Scientific research has demonstrated strong evidence that Folate when paired with Vitamin B12 can effectively keep blood homocysteine levels under control. Homocysteine is a type of amino acid that can contribute to the formation of blood clots and cause arteries to narrow and harden. L-methylfolate and Folic Acid supplements should be taken with 1000mcg of Vitamin B12 to prevent B12 deficiency.

longDescription: Vitamin D is a fat-soluble vitamin, which can be created by the body when the skin is exposed to sunshine for a small amount of time. description: Garlic is a member of the onion, leek and chive family. Black garlic is made when heads of garlic are aged under specialized conditions of heat and humidity, then the enzymes which give garlic its pungent taste and odour are broken down. Black Garlic has double the nutrients of normal white garlic; it is sweeter in taste and leaves no unpleasant aftertaste or smell. A substance called S-allylcysteine is found to be only in Black Garlic. S-allylcysteine and other compounds found in Black Garlic are known as active phytonutrients.

details.description: Garlic is a member of the onion, leek and chive family. Black garlic is made when heads of garlic are aged under specialized conditions of heat and humidity, then the enzymes which give garlic its pungent taste and odour are broken down. Black Garlic has double the nutrients of normal white garlic; it is sweeter in taste and leaves no unpleasant aftertaste or smell. name: Starflower Oil™ 1000mg (23% GLA) Capsules
description: Starflower Oil, also known as borage oil, is extracted from the seeds of the borage plant. It contains the richest source of gamma linolenic acid (GLA). It has a much higher content of GLA than Evening Primrose Oil. GLA cannot be produced by the body, so we must consume enough GLA within our diet or take supplements containing GLA. GLA is converted into Prostaglandin, a hormone-like substance which has been believed to provide numerous health benefits. Starflower Oil contains added Vitamin E, which is a powerful antioxidant that provides protection of cells from oxidative stress.

details.description: Vitamin D is a fat-soluble vitamin, which can be created by the body when the skin is exposed to sunshine for a small amount of time. Certain factors such as the amount of melanin found in your skin, limited sun exposure and lack of Vitamin D in foods can deplete Vitamin D stored within the body over time. A lack of Vitamin D can lead to symptoms such as lethargy, tiredness, muscle problems, bone pains and mood changes. Vitamin D is important for a range of bodily functions, and supplementation alongside a healthy diet can contribute to the normal absorption and utilisation of Calcium and Phosphorus, which is important for the maintenance of normal bones and teeth. Vitamin D is also used within the body to maintain the normal functioning of the immune system, cell division, and helps maintain normal muscle function. HealthAid® Vitamin D Spray is perfect for children and those who are unable to swallow tablets.

name: Lecithin 1200mg (unbleached) Capsules
description: Lecithin is formulated using cold pressed soybean oil. It is a natural emulsifier that assists in the breakdown of fats and transportation of fats through blood vessels. Lecithin is a rich source of Choline and Inositol. Choline and Inositol are lipotropins, which help burn excessive fat and contribute to homocysteine and lipid metabolism. Choline is a precursor to the neurotransmitter, acetylcholine, which plays a role in brain and muscle function. Inositol is a major component of cell membranes, which helps manage insulin and chemical messengers in the brain. Lecithin contains added Vitamin E, which is a powerful antioxidant that provides protection of cells from oxidative stress.

name: Vegan Omega 3 - 6 - 9 Capsules
description: HealthAid® Omega 3, 6, 9, sourced from Flaxseed Oil, contains high-quality essential fatty acids. The body cannot produce Omega-3 and 6, Omega 9 is produced by the body, however due to poor diet we cannot always produce enough. Therefore, Omega-3, 6 and 9 need to be provided by a healthy diet and supplementation. Omega-3 provides Alpha-Linoleic Acid (ALA), which contributes to normal blood cholesterol levels. Omega 6 is a rich source of GLA (Gamma-Linolenic Acid), which may benefit general body metabolism. Omega 9 is a rich source of Oleic Acid, which is helpful in supporting cardiovascular health. Vegan Omega 3, 6, 9 is particularly beneficial for brain function and vision.

name: Starflower Oil (23% GLA) Oil
description: Starflower Oil, also known as borage oil, is extracted from the seeds of the borage plant. It contains the richest source of gamma linolenic acid (GLA). It has a much higher content of GLA than Evening Primrose Oil. GLA cannot be produced by the body, so we must consume enough GLA within our diet or take supplements containing GLA. GLA is converted into Prostaglandin, a hormone-like substance which has been believed to provide numerous health benefits.

name: Alpha Lipoic Acid 250mg
description: Alpha-lipoic acid (ALA) is a naturally occurring compound that serves as a coenzyme involved in biochemical reactions within the body. It is both water and fat-soluble, which allows it to work in different cellular environments. Alpha Lipoic Acid (ALA) is one of the most powerful antioxidants that is used throughout the body to attack and neutralise damaging free radicals. These are toxin-like molecules that cause oxidative damage to cell walls, mitochondria or DNA, which contribute to numerous health problems and can speed up the ageing process. Alpha Lipoic Acid may aid in safeguarding cells, boosting energy, regulating blood sugar, promoting neurological well-being and enhancing skin.

description: Lutein is a major component of the macular pigment in the eye, which filters out harmful high-energy blue light and protects the retina. Higher macular pigment density is associated with better visual performance and reduced glare sensitivity. Lutein is believed to help maintain healthy vision by protecting the eyes from oxidative stress caused by exposure to ultraviolet (UV) light and blue light. It is also believed to have a positive impact on cardiovascular and skin health by reducing inflammation and oxidative stress, which are risk factors for heart disease and skin conditions. HealthAid® Lutein is extracted from marigold flowers.

name: Vitamin B6 (Pyridoxine HCl) 100mg Tablets
description: Low mood and hormonal changes can lead to extra pressure on Vitamin B in the body. A lack of Vitamin B6 can lead to signs such as a skin rash, a low mood, and an irritated and red tongue. As an essential Vitamin necessary for a range of processes in the body, Pyridoxine HCl (or Vitamin B6) is easily supplemented when dietary needs are not sufficient. Vitamin B6 contributes to normal homocysteine, protein and glycogen metabolism. It is also important in hormone regulation, formation of red blood cells and muscle coordination. Adequate intake of vitamin B6 through diet or supplementation is necessary for the proper functioning of the nervous system.

name: Biotin 800µg Tablets
description: Dull hair and sagging skin? The ageing process comes with a whole range of less than favourable beauty issues. There is good news, supplement your healthy diet with Biotin to support healthy skin, nails and hair. Biotin is especially known as a beauty vitamin. It thickens hair, increases elasticity and prevents dryness and breakage of the hair. It also helps to make keratin, a primary component of healthy hair. In addition, Biotin helps carry oxygen to the cells in the follicles, making them energised and healthy. This is one of the reasons why Biotin has been proven to be very beneficial in preventing hair from becoming brittle and dull. Biotin supports healthy skin growth.

Vitamin B6 contributes to normal homocysteine, protein and glycogen metabolism. It is also important in hormone regulation, formation of red blood cells and muscle coordination. Adequate intake of vitamin B6 through diet or supplementation is necessary for the proper functioning of the nervous system.

longDescription: Vitamin D is a fat-soluble vitamin, which can be created by the body when the skin is exposed to sunshine for a small amount of time. Certain factors such as the amount of melanin found in your skin, limited sun exposure and lack of Vitamin D in foods can deplete Vitamin D stored within the body over time. A lack of Vitamin D can lead to symptoms such as lethargy, tiredness, muscle problems, bone pains and mood changes. Vitamin D is important for a range of bodily functions, and supplementation alongside a healthy diet can contribute to the normal absorption and utilisation of Calcium and Phosphorus, which is important for the maintenance of normal bones and teeth. Vitamin D is also used within the body to maintain the normal functioning of the immune system, cell division, and helps maintain normal muscle function.

details.description: Vitamin D is a fat-soluble vitamin, which can be created by the body when the skin is exposed to sunshine for a small amount of time. Certain factors such as the amount of melanin found in your skin, limited sun exposure and lack of Vitamin D in foods can deplete Vitamin D stored within the body over time. A lack of Vitamin D can lead to symptoms such as lethargy, tiredness, muscle problems, bone pains and mood changes. Vitamin D is important for a range of bodily functions, and supplementation alongside a healthy diet can contribute to the normal absorption and utilisation of Calcium and Phosphorus, which is important for the maintenance of normal bones and teeth. Vitamin D is also used within the body to maintain the normal functioning of the immune system, cell division, and helps maintain normal muscle function.

longDescription: Cholesterol is a naturally occurring fat-like substance that the body needs to function optimally. Within the body, there are different types of cholesterol, some are beneficial and others harmful for the body. The harmful type, known as Low-Density Lipoproteins (LDL Cholesterol) or bad cholesterol, can lead to artery blockages and potentially severe heart conditions. LDL Cholesterol tends to accumulate and create plaque in artery walls. On the other hand, the beneficial type, called High-Density Lipoproteins (HDL Cholesterol), helps manage the levels of bad cholesterol in the bloodstream. Certain nutrients and plant extracts are beneficial in the balance of good cholesterol and bad cholesterol. Colestroforte® contains key Nutrients, Amino Acids and Herbs to help contribute to a healthy blood circulation and heart. Artichoke extract, Red Rice Yeast, Oat Brand, Gugulipids and Soy Isoflavones assist in the balance of cholesterol in the body and contrbute to the protection of cells from oxidative stress.

longDescription: We’ve all heard how carrots are good for your eyesight, but how? All because of a special Phyto-nutrient called Beta-Carotene, which is abundant in certain fruits and vegetables. longDescription: Carboslim® Capsules have been designed to assist those on a low carbohydrate weight management programme. longDescription: Unfortunately, due to many different factors Vitamin B12 deficiency is a common and growing problem today. Evening Primrose Oil contains added Vitamin E, which is a powerful antioxidant that provides protection of cells from oxidative stress.

Proteins are a necessary part of every living cell in the body, next to the water. In the human body, proteins substances make up the muscles, ligaments, tendons, organs, glands, nails, hair and many vital body fluids and are essential for the growth of bones. Free-form means the amino acids is in its purest form. It does not need any digestion and is absorbed directly into the bloodstream.

longDescription: Unfortunately, due to many different factors Vitamin B12 deficiency is a common and growing problem today. Both adults and children often find themselves with signs of a Vitamin B12 deficiency without realisation. A deficiency may show as signs such as mental fogginess, poor memory and concentration, fatigue, irritation, feelings of apathy and lack of motivation, mood swings, muscle weakness, or sleeping problems. longDescription: Vitamin D is a fat-soluble vitamin, which can be created by the body when the skin is exposed to sunshine for a small amount of time. Certain factors such as the amount of melanin found in your skin, limited sun exposure and lack of Vitamin D in foods can deplete Vitamin D stored within the body over time. A lack of Vitamin D can lead to symptoms such as lethargy, tiredness, muscle problems, bone pains and mood changes. Vitamin D is important for a range of bodily functions, and supplementation alongside a healthy diet can contribute to the normal absorption and utilisation of Calcium and Phosphorus, which is important for the maintenance of normal bones and teeth. Vitamin D is also used within the body to maintain the normal functioning of the immune system, cell division, and helps maintain normal muscle function. name: D-Ribose 1000mg Tablets
description: Adenosine triphosphate (ATP) is often referred to as the energy currency of life because the amount that we have in our tissues determines how much energy we have. It is needed to help our hearts and muscles to contract. Brain requires it to perform its cognitive functions fluently. It is also involved in countless other actions that we don’t consciously control. D-Ribose is the key building block of ATP, therefore the availability of D-Ribose is vital for energy production and recovery. When the cells in muscles such as the heart come under metabolic stress, they are unable to synthesise enough D-Ribose and as a result, energy levels are depleted.

name: Red Yeast Rice Tablets
description: Red Yeast Rice is a substance extracted from rice that has been fermented with a type of yeast called Monascus purpureus. It is a very popular food in Asian countries where it has been traditionally used for centuries to benefit health. Active compounds called Monacolins, most importantly Monacolin K (also known as lovastatin), are naturally-occurring HMG-CoA inhibitors found in Red Yeast Rice. It also contains natural Sterols (Beta-sitosterol and Campesterol), Isoflavones, and Monounsaturated Fatty Acids ("healthy fats"). HealthAid® Red Yeast Rice is fortified with Chromium which contributes to the maintenance of normal blood glucose levels.

name: Aquaflow® Tablets
description: Water retention is an abnormal build-up of excess fluid (water) within the body. When the smallest blood vessels (capillaries), begin to leak water into tissues, it causes puffiness. Women usually experience it before menstruation or during pregnancy. Other factors that may contribute to water retention include deficiency of magnesium, potassium and Vitamin B6, dehydration, poor kidney function, sluggish circulation and hormonal imbalance. Aquaflow® Tablets are an original combination of Potassium and Vitamin B6 together with the goodness of Cranberries, Citrus Bioflavonoids, and high-quality Herbs (Juniper and Parsley Extracts).

longDescription: Methylcobalamin is regarded as the final and most bio-available form of Vitamin B12 (Cobalamin). Unfortunately, due to many different factors, Vitamin B12 deficiency is a common and growing problem today. It is common for individuals to have signs of a Vitamin B12 deficiency without even knowing. A deficiency may show signs such as mental fogginess, poor memory and concentration, fatigue, irritation, lack of motivation, mood swings, muscle weakness and sleeping problems. Lack of this Vitamin may also contribute to weakened immunity. Vitamin B12 is important for good mental and physical health. It is one of the largest and most complicated Vitamins that is only produced by certain probiotic bacterial species. In the body Vitamin B12 is used in DNA to form red blood cells and haemoglobin. It contributes to normal brain functionality, immune system function, energy production, and the metabolism of fats, carbohydrates and proteins. It supports the heart and cardiovascular system by maintaining normal homocysteine levels.

details.description: Methylcobalamin is regarded as the final and most bio-available form of Vitamin B12 (Cobalamin). Unfortunately, due to many different factors, Vitamin B12 deficiency is a common and growing problem today. It is common for individuals to have signs of a Vitamin B12 deficiency without even knowing. A deficiency may show signs such as mental fogginess, poor memory and concentration, fatigue, irritation, lack of motivation, mood swings, muscle weakness and sleeping problems. Lack of this Vitamin may also contribute to weakened immunity. Vitamin B12 is important for good mental and physical health. It is one of the largest and most complicated Vitamins that is only produced by certain probiotic bacterial species. In the body Vitamin B12 is used in DNA to form red blood cells and haemoglobin. It contributes to normal brain functionality, immune system function, energy production, and the metabolism of fats, carbohydrates and proteins. It supports the heart and cardiovascular system by maintaining normal homocysteine levels.

longDescription: During the digestion process, the body secretes essential acids and enzymes to help break down food so that it can be readily absorbed into the bloodstream and utilised as energy. Occasionally the ability to adequately produce these enzymes is impaired and our food does not get properly digested, causing discomfort, bloating and wind. Digeston® Max is a unique blend of many purely vegan Digestive Enzymes including Amylase, Protease and Lipase which are required to digest carbohydrates, proteins and fats. name: 5 Hydroxytryptophan (5-HTP) 50mg - Prolonged Release Tablets
description: 5-HTP (5-Hydroxytryptophan) is derived from the seeds of the Griffonia simplicifolia plant. 5-HTP is a naturally occurring Amino Acid that aids the production of the important brain neurotransmitter, Serotonin. Serotonin is involved in mood and emotion regulation, behaviour patterns, appetite control, and sleep mechanisms. Tryptophan is obtained from the diet and converted into 5HTP within the body. 5-HTP is able to cross the blood-brain barrier, where it is transformed into Serotonin. 5-HTP is commonly used to support cognitive function by managing mental health (stress and symptoms of depression and anxiety), sleeping patterns, fibromyalgia and migraine relief.

tabs.Περιγραφή: Evening Primrose Oil is made from the seeds of a flowering plant native to North America. Evening Primrose Oil is a rich source gamma-linolenic acid (GLA). GLA cannot be produced by the body, so we must consume enough GLA within our diet, or aid GLA intake through supplementation. GLA is converted into Prostaglandin, a hormone-like substance which has been believed to provide numerous health benefits.
tabs.Οφέλη:
Rich source of gamma-linolenic acid (GLA)
Cold-pressed to maintain freshness and purity
Can be used internally and externally
tabs.Συστατικά:
Pure Evening Primrose Oil (Oenothera biennis), with a minimum 10% GLA.
